column1: # 1.12 item and entity ids in mod data, and what each one became.
#   item    OLD with META (a number, or - for every value) became NEW in SINCE
#   entity  OLD became NEW in SINCE
#   family  every META value of OLD is covered by the vanilla tag NEW (META is *)
#   also    an ingredient or predicate naming OLD with META accepts NEW as well
# Rows with SINCE 1.13 read 1.12 ids. Later rows read the id an earlier row produced,
# so a reference is carried to the name its target version reads, one release at a time.
# Derived by scripts/harvest-legacy-item-flattening.py from the 1.12.2 and 1.13 client jars:
# the 1.13 rows are the 1.13 item flattening map and the 1.13 rename maps, read from the
# 1.13 jar's data fixers. Later rows and families were checked against the client jars of
# id is present before SINCE, the new id from SINCE on, and nothing the 1.13 rows produce
# disappears from a release without a later row. Regenerate after a vanilla rename.
# Every 1.12 vanilla recipe, translated through these rows, shares an item in each ingredient
# with 1.13's recipe for the same result. Where the fixer disagreed, the rows follow those
